GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield on inside (6L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & Two Wide @ 700m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & held ground in last 200m. # Steady effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 4th 3 Lengths . laid out in Straight , Held Ground before tiring last 100m # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in throughout the event. In the vicinity of the 1000m  shifted in and away from another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out Ridden Along early but keen early stages Settled Down Mid Field 5l 3back fence home turn 6.5l Saved Ground rails through gone 100 Dropped Out # keen/folded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Drifted Back 2nd last 8 Lengths . saved ground into Straight , had Good Run Through along Inside , made steady ground although he was in restricted room late # made good ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m became held up for a short  distance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Quickly Drifted Back 2nd last 6 Lengths . laid out rounding home turn , ran on hard from 200m taking Lead late # big win from back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: slow to begin. Laid out rounding the home turn and in the straight.
